about_the_game:
In a cyberpunk wasteland ruled by AI, humanity’s “Eternal Happiness” project has spiraled out of control. Most humans, trapped in dream-filled pods, have lost their ambition, while the Resistance fights desperately to reclaim freedom.
You—once an elite AI Peacekeeper Captain—suffer damage to your control chip during a mission, awakening your free will.
Will you return to order… or bring chaos to the world?

Key Features

  • Multiple Endings: Decide humanity’s fate—restore order or embrace chaos.

  • Metroidvania Exploration: Unlock new skills, gear, and shortcuts to revisit and conquer expansive levels.

  • Deep Combat System: Side-scrolling shooting with gear customization, skill upgrades, and tactical variety.

  • Pixel Cyber-Military Aesthetic: A fusion of ruined wastelands and futuristic tech in a detailed pixel art style.

Traverse abandoned factories, neon nightclubs, sewers, orbital elevators, and lunar bases. Face mechanical armies, cybernetic elites, and the cold, godlike AI core—every choice you make will split the world’s future into a new path.
